spans.s:
मोरट मोरट, अस्, m. a species of plant
with sweet juice (= क्षीर-मोरट); the milk of a
cow recently calved, biestings, (according to lexico-
graphers, अम्, n.); (आ), f. = मूर्वा, hemp used for
bow-strings, Sanseviera Roxburghiana; (अम्), n. the
root of the sugar-cane; the flower of Alangium
Hexapetalum; the root of this plant.
मोरटक, अम्, n. the root of the sugar-cane.

मोराक मोराक, अस्, m., N. of king Pravara-
sena's minister (founder of the temple called after
him मोराक-भवन).
मोरिका मोरिका, f., N. of a female poet.
मोर्वणीकर मोर्वणी-कर, अस्, m. a proper N.
